newsitem.title: PANAMA: Panama's total public debt falls to $6.99 billion.
newsitem.headline: Panama's total public debt falls to $6.99 billion.

text.p: Panama's Ministry for Planning and Economic Policy said Friday net total public debt fell $446.4 million to $6.990 billion on March 30 1997, from $7.437 billion on August 31, 1994.

Out of total debt, foreign debt stood at $5.345 billion on March 31, compared to $5.464 billion on August 31 1994, according to figures published by the Ministry for Planning and Economic Policy in local newspapers.
Internal debt meanwhile stood at $1.645 billion on March 31, compared with $1.973 billion on August 31, 1994.
The Ministry did not provide any explanations for the drop in the notice.
((-- Paul de Bendern, Panama City newsroom 507 223 7739))
